title: Configure the compilation, interpreter, and build processes to improve executable security
reason: Not applicable: nothing is compiled to native code. The engine is Python and bash run by the pinned interpreters of scripts/cloud/toolchain.json, and the site is TypeScript bundled by Next.js and run on the Node.js of an image pinned by digest; the security features of those interpreters and runtimes are their suppliers' (SUP-nodejs, SUP-aws), and the build's inputs are pinned (PO.3, PW.4).
